findings.title: The staged case evidence loses its profile and dependency links
findings.evidence: Original site-draft/evidence/README.md:3,20 retains four repository-relative references. Independent audit.json records four missing/escaping targets and HTTP 404 for all four at /qore-codex-skills/. Original tools/check_site.py exits 0 with valid=true and 25 references despite them.
findings.counterexample: Follow the showcase Candidate identities, provenance and remaining limits link to evidence/README.md, then follow its project-profile or coordination-dependency link. On the intended /qore-codex-skills/ deployment these relative URLs escape the project prefix, and neither destination is staged. The source checkout links work; the built public presentation links do not.
